# Stakeholder Processes

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

Use this file for PM-23 through PM-29.

| ID | Process | Purpose | Inputs | Outputs | Tailoring | Check | Authority | PMI source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM-23 | Identify Stakeholders | Identify people and groups who affect or are affected by the work. | Charter, business case, organizational context, source documents | Stakeholder register, influence and interest notes, engagement needs | Revisit when scope, organization, or impact changes. | Relevant stakeholders, roles, interests, influence, and engagement needs are recorded. | May identify and record; stakeholder ownership remains with project leadership. | 2.5.2.1 |
| PM-24 | Plan Stakeholder Engagement | Decide how relationships and participation will be managed. | Stakeholder register, expectations, decision rights, risks, culture | Engagement approach, participation plan, escalation path | Use a focused plan for small aligned groups; formal plan for conflict or high influence. | Desired behavior, channel, owner, timing, and feedback route are explicit. | Drafts plan; PM confirms material engagement commitments. | 2.5.2.2 |
| PM-25 | Plan Communications Management | Define information needs, messages, channels, timing, and records. | Stakeholder needs, governance, schedule, data sources, confidentiality rules | Communications plan, reporting calendar, message responsibilities | Match formality and frequency to audience need and decision tempo. | Each important audience has a useful message, source, channel, cadence, and owner. | Drafts plan; PM approves material communication commitments. | 2.5.2.3 |
| PM-26 | Manage Stakeholder Engagement | Work with stakeholders to sustain alignment and resolve concerns. | Engagement plan, stakeholder feedback, decisions, issues, changes | Engagement records, resolved concerns, proposed decisions or escalations | Use direct collaboration for adaptive work and formal forums when authority is distributed. | Feedback is acknowledged, decisions are traceable, and unresolved conflict is visible. | May facilitate and record; PM decides commitments and escalations. | 2.5.2.4 |
| PM-27 | Manage Communications | Deliver timely and appropriate project information. | Communications plan, status data, decisions, risks, audience needs | Communications, meeting records, distribution evidence, feedback | Tailor format and cadence; do not create reports that duplicate registers without purpose. | Recipient, message, source, date, decision or action required, and follow-up are clear. | Prepares and distributes when authorized; does not represent unapproved decisions. | 2.5.2.5 |
| PM-28 | Monitor Stakeholder Engagement | Check whether engagement supports project outcomes. | Stakeholder register, feedback, attendance, decisions, issues | Engagement assessment, gaps, proposed responses, updated stakeholder data | Monitor at decision points or when stakeholder conditions change. | Evidence shows whether expected participation and influence are occurring. | Recommends response; PM decides material relationship action. | 2.5.2.6 |
| PM-29 | Monitor Communications | Check whether communication is reaching the right people and producing action. | Communications plan, delivery records, feedback, decisions, reports | Communication effectiveness review, gaps, corrective proposals | Use sampling for stable low-risk work; detailed review for sensitive or regulated communication. | Required information reached the intended audience in time and was understood enough to act. | Recommends changes; PM decides material communication commitments. | 2.5.2.7 |
